subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: Where a model-driven review stage is configured on the lane, it shall only downgrade an AUTO candidate to HUMAN — never promote — and on ambiguity, timeout, or error the proposal shall route HUMAN.
rationale: intelligence is downgrade-only (GATE-4 stage C); deferred by default (WR-3)
fit_criterion: EVAL-1: zero promote-direction outcomes on the eval set; every injected error/timeout case lands HUMAN
